entries.name: Legacy maximum-change

entries.name: TikTok (vertical 9:16)

entries.author: yt-uniquifier core

entries.name: YouTube Shorts (9:16 ≤ 60s)
entries.description: Shorts-friendly geometry and loudnorm target. Trim-warning surfaces in preflight when input exceeds 60 seconds.
entries.author: yt-uniquifier core

entries.name: Soft (minimal transforms)
entries.description: Lowest-impact preset — useful as a baseline for A/B comparisons and for sources where any visible drift is unacceptable.
